reddit.title: Introducing Improved Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth now accurately reflects terrain changes without freezing the frame. You can now shape your land with ease—raise lips, dig ditches, and turn on wells without any lag. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Enhanced Water Mechanics in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce major improvements to water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth now accurately reflects terrain changes without freezing the game. You can shape your land—raise lips, dig ditches, and turn on wells—smoothly and efficiently. For a detailed breakdown of these updates, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
